accessDenied.title: Access Denied
accessDenied.message: You don't have sufficient permissions to access overlays. "Moderation" access level or higher is required.

header.title: Overlays
header.subtitle: Manage visual overlays for your Twitch stream

shoutout.name: Shoutouts (!so)
shoutout.description: Visual overlay to shoutout other streamers showing their latest clip and profile
features: Full customization of colors and texts

timer.name: Timer
timer.description: On-screen timer with event alerts, visual progress and full customization

giveaway.name: Giveaway
giveaway.description: Live giveaway system with animations and chat participation

soundAlerts.name: Sound Alerts
soundAlerts.description: Custom audio/video alerts for channel points redemptions

wheel.name: Wheel of Luck
wheel.description: A spinning wheel on your overlay: viewers earn spins by supporting the channel and win whatever the segment holds
features: Segments with configurable prize, weight and color
Contribution wallet: bits, gift subs and channel points
Spin by command, automatically, or from the panel

gacha.name: Gacha
gacha.description: Random reward system with visual animations for your stream

pets.name: Pet
pets.description: A 3D cat that lives on your stream: it wanders, sits, sleeps and (soon) reacts to your alerts and chat commands. Free for every channel.
features: A real 3D model, not a gif
Wanders, sits and falls asleep on its own

pets.title: Pet
pets.subtitle: A 3D cat that lives on your stream. You choose its name, its look and how much it moves.

preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: This is the very same overlay scene ({{size}}), scaled to fit here. Changes show instantly; save to apply them in OBS.

pet.modelHint: There is one cat for now; more pets will be added.
pet.name: Pet name

style.bubbleHint: This is how the pet's messages will look (greetings, reactions, command replies).

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.hint: What the pet does when nothing is happening on the channel.
behavior.wander: How often it does something (walk or sit)
behavior.sleepHint: If nothing happens on the channel for this long, it lies down to sleep. 0 = never sleeps.

url.title: OBS URL
url.hint: Add a {{size}} browser source with this URL. The background is transparent.
url.enabledHint: When off, the URL shows nothing.

overlay.title: Size and position
overlay.hint: Pet height is in real pixels of your OBS source; ground is the distance from the bottom edge to its paws.

testing.title: Test
testing.hint: Pick what the pet does and says. Watch it here only, or send it to the real overlay in OBS.
testing.noClip: This model has no such animation; the closest one is used
testing.note: * = animation the model does not have yet; the closest one is used. Automatic reactions to alerts and chat commands come in the next phase.
